# mv: move type and const to a file
mv T C y.go
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

const C = 42

func F() T { return T{X: C} }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,7 +1,3 @@
 package m

-type T struct{ X int }
-
-const C = 42
-
 func F() T { return T{X: C} }

--- old/y.go
+++ new/y.go
